message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, your latest draft does finish Alex’s speech; what can that completed passage tell you about a manageable revision size? You intended an “English revision”; what difference between that intention and the displayed text deserves attention now? Why would further thought be worth its time over a small attempt, and what unresolved uncertainty could justify waiting? What textual evidence would decide? Could you briefly give your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next step in English, then carry out your choice?
